title: Chapter
description: A chapter within a book. Aggregates scenes; carries structural metadata about its position and role in the act.

title.description: Optional chapter title or working label.

act.description: Act number this chapter belongs to (1–3 for three-act; up to 5 for five-act).

word_count_target.description: Target word count for all scenes in this chapter combined.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scene IDs belonging to this chapter.

pov_character_id.description: Default POV character for this chapter. Individual scenes may override. Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

hook.description: Opening-hook description for outliner/spec. Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

cliffhanger_required.description: Whether this chapter must end on a cliffhanger or chapter-turn hook. Driven by genre_profile.structural_conventions.

arc_function.description: The structural role of this chapter in the overall arc (e.g. inciting_incident, dark_night, climax). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.
